fib: ______ is the exclusive right to use materials in certain ways.
Copyright

Journalism
Journalism is the art and science of gathering, selecting and processing information or ideas, intelligence for dissemination to the public.
______ means that a report must be fair, frank, straight-forward, objective, and sincere in purpose.
Being candid
Being candid means that a report must be fair, frank, straight-forward, objective, and sincere in purpose.
______ is one of the most important legislature provisions that affect the journalists.
law of copyright
The law of copyright is one of the most important legislature provisions that affect the journalists.
______ refers to the sources of information opened to the journalist.
'where' of news

______ is a sample of headlines used by a particular newspaper, It shows the point size, types and type faces available and the precise form they must take.
headline schedule

______ is a reporter's basic tool, central activity in his daily job.
Interviewing

______ is the form in which the journalist reports events.
news story
The news story is the form in which the journalist reports events.
______ is that which has to be written in a succinct way, avoiding pointless elaboration, exaggeration, tautology or circumlocution.
concise write-up
A concise write-up is that which has to be written in a succinct way, avoiding pointless elaboration, exaggeration, tautology or circumlocution.
______ means checking and cross-checking figures, names of persons, town/cities, facts, spellings, maps etc.
Correctness

______ are those which the techniques of interviewing are applied effectively.
best interviews

investigative report
